Description

The Activity Flow map of the Osteoarthritis pain map as its authors drew it and as it is on MINERVA, converted to yEd without changes; only the compartments are drawn in MINERVA's grey. It shows the mast cell's eicosanoids, the nociceptor's receptors and their signalling to the action potential, and the spinal nociceptive neuron, with logic gates for receptors acting together and for ion entry.

Colour

The authors' colours: proteins yellow, metabolites beige, drugs darker yellow.
